00101288.name: rxInitDevices

001037c0.name: Heap::setMark

001038a0.why: (heap, ptr, size): under the heap semaphore, keeps the block when its size (header -0x10, +4 & 0x3fffffff) already fits, else moves it to a bigger block (rest of the body not read in detail); PtrList::add uses it

00103aa0.name: Heap::free
00103aa0.why: (heap, p): WaitSema(heap+0) when >= 0, unlink block p-0x10 (0x103b10), SignalSema; heap object 0x329970 serves operator delete; may be MSL's pool allocator, class name provisional

00103c50.name: Heap::alloc
00103c50.why: (heap, size, align): same semaphore guard around 0x103cd0; operator new passes align 16

001045a0.name: shutdownGlobalHeap

00104600.name: initGlobalHeap
00104600.why: (size, <= 0 means all but -size): sizes free RAM from 0x31a880..0x31a888 (else 32 MB - end - 0x2000), probes with _malloc_r / _free_r, then _malloc_r's block becomes the heap 0x329970 (0x104500)

00104c60.name: __construct_array
00104c60.why: MSL runtime (ptr, ctor, dtor, size, n): ctor(p, 1) per element, destroys constructed ones in reverse on failure; static initialiser 0x310a00 and array members use it

00104ee0.name: std::exception::~exception
00104ee0.why: slot 0 of std::exception's vtable 0x310fe0: stores the vptr, deletes this when the flag > 0

001051a0.name: std::terminate
001051a0.why: calls the handler stored at 0x2f1060, which holds 0x1051d0 by default

001051d0.name: dthandler
001051d0.why: MW's default terminate handler (initial value of 0x2f1060): calls abort 0x121ef0

001051f0.name: __destroy_global_chain
001051f0.why: MW runtime: pops 0x329b48 entries and calls dtor(obj, -1); main's last call (thunk 0x100270)

00105250.name: __register_global_object
00105250.why: MW runtime (obj, dtor, entry): links {next, dtor, obj} at the head of the global destructor chain 0x329b48

00105280.name: __call_static_initializers
00105280.why: calls every function pointer in [a0, a1) (the static-initialiser table 0x310fb0..0x310fd4), then 0x106930(a2, a3) (an empty range, returns 0); descriptive name

00106830.name: __throw
00106830.why: MW runtime (type string, object, dtor): MSL string code throws out_of_range with 0x2fe540 '!std::out_of_range!...' and dtor 0x107220

001070f0.name: std::logic_error::~logic_error
001070f0.why: slot 0 of 0x311010: destroys the message string at +4 (0x106b80), then the exception base

00107180.name: std::length_error::~length_error
00107180.why: slot 0 of 0x310ff0: length_error -> logic_error -> exception vptr chain

00107220.name: std::out_of_range::~out_of_range
00107220.why: slot 0 of 0x311000; MSL string throws pass it to __throw as the dtor

001076e8.name: sceGsResetGraph
001076e8.why: libgraph (mode, inter, omode, ffmode): mode 0 resets GS_CSR, stores the GParam, GsPutIMR(0xff00), drops the VSync handler, SetGsCrt; mode 1 CSR=0x100; mode 5 SetGsCrt only

00107878.name: sceGsGetGParam
00107878.why: libgraph: returns the GS parameter block 0x2f1090 (+0 interlace mode, +8 VSync callback, +0xc its handler id)

00107888.name: sceGsResetPath
00107888.why: libgraph: VIF1_FBRST / ERR, VU1 reset via ctc2 vi28 | 0x200, two init qwords into the VIF1 FIFO, GIF_CTRL reset

00107ea0.name: sceGsSetDefDrawEnv
00107ea0.why: libgraph (env, psm, w, h, ztest, zpsm): writes FRAME_1 0x4c, ZBUF_1 0x4e, XYOFFSET_1 0x18 (0x800 - w/2), SCISSOR_1 0x40, PRMODECONT 0x1a, COLCLAMP 0x46, DTHE 0x45, TEST_1

00108088.name: sceGsSetDefClear
00108088.why: libgraph (clear, ztest, x, y, w, h, r, g, b, a, z): TEST_1 0x47, PRIM 6 sprite, RGBAQ 1, two XYZ2 5 corners scaled by 16, restores TEST; returns 6 qwords

00108278.name: sceGsSyncV
00108278.why: libgraph: waits for vblank and returns the field bit (CSR bit 13) when interlaced; gameInit loops on it

00108310.name: sceGsSyncPath
00108310.why: libgraph: waits on VIF1 / GIF DMA, VIF1_STAT, VU1 and GIF_STAT; prints 'sceGsSyncPath: DMA Ch.1 does not terminate' (0x2fe730) on timeout; mode != 0 returns the busy mask

00109270.name: sceGsSyncVCallback
00109270.why: libgraph: replaces GParam+8 / +0xc with AddIntcHandler(INTC_VBLANK_S 2, fn), Remove + DisableIntc for 0; returns the previous callback

00109468.name: sceDmaGetChan
00109468.why: libdma (id): returns the channel register block from the table 0x2f10e0 for id < 10, else NULL

00109490.name: sceDmaReset
00109490.why: libdma (enable): clears CHCR / MADR / QWC / TADR / ASR of the 10 channels, acks DMAC_STAT, re-arms, sets DMAC_CTRL bit 0 when 1; returns the old enable bit

00109798.name: sceDmaSend
00109798.why: libdma (chan, tag): waits for the channel, TADR = tag (0x109408 maps scratchpad), QWC 0, CHCR = (CHCR & ~0xc) | 0x105 (from memory, source chain, start)

00109a38.name: sceDmaSync
00109a38.why: libdma (chan, mode, timeout): mode 1 returns CHCR.STR, else waits through 0x109310

0010ac60.name: sceVif1PkReset
0010ac60.why: libvifpk (packet): pCurrent = pBase, pDmaTag = 0 (sceVif1Packet {pCurrent, pBase, pDmaTag, ...}); Vif1PktManage::Reset runs it on each list; likely name, shape matches

0010ac70.name: sceVif1PkCloseDmaTag
0010ac70.why: libvifpk (packet): pads pCurrent to a quadword with zeros, adds the qwords written to the open DMA tag's QWC, pDmaTag = 0; likely name

0010ad20.name: sceVif1PkNext
0010ad20.why: libvifpk (packet, addr, opt): closes the open tag (sceVif1PkCloseDmaTag), writes a DMA next tag (id 2 | opt, addr & 0x9fffffff) and opens it; likely name

0011e290.name: sceCdReadClock
0011e290.why: libcdvd (clock*): SIF call fno 1 on the cd clock client 0x2f2f00 into a 0x10-byte buffer copied out as {stat, sec, min, hour, pad, day, month, year} (BCD); getLocalDateTime reads it; likely name, shape matches

0011e440.name: scePadInit
0011e440.why: libpad: binds SIF RPC 0x80000100 / 0x80000101 (padman), checks the module version and prints 'libpad: Module version mismatch' (0x2ffea8); padSysInit calls it with 0

0011e898.name: scePadPortOpen
0011e898.why: libpad (port, slot, buffer): 'libpad: buffer addr is not 64 byte align' / 'pad port is already open [%d][%d]' strings, SIF call to padman with the buffer

00121ef0.name: abort
00121ef0.why: raise(6) then _exit(1); Ghidra's body also swallows the next function (an abs: negate if < 0) after the noreturn call

00123538.name: exit
00123538.why: Sony libc (newlib): runs _impure_ptr->_atexit (+0x148) handlers in reverse, then __cleanup (+0x3c), then _exit; entry jumps here with main's result

00123b18.name: _free_r
00123b18.why: newlib dlmalloc free (reent, p): chunk header at p-8 with the in-use bit, merges into the top chunk 0x2f33b0, __malloc_lock 0x1254a0 first

00124950.name: _malloc_r
00124950.why: newlib (reent, size); initGlobalHeap calls it with _impure_ptr 0x2f3398, pairs with _free_r 0x123b18

001278f8.name: _raise_r
001278f8.why: newlib reentrant raise, called by raise 0x127a68 with _impure_ptr

00127a68.name: raise
00127a68.why: newlib wrapper: _raise_r(_impure_ptr 0x2f3398, sig); abort calls it with 6 (SIGABRT)

00128380.name: strcpy
00128380.why: same zero-byte scan copying 16/8 bytes per step, then the tail byte by byte; MSL throw sites strcpy the message into a strlen+1 buffer

00128498.name: strlen
00128498.why: R5900 quadword/doubleword zero-byte scan (0x0101.. / 0x8080.. masks), returns end - start

0012cd20.name: gsEndFrameSync
0012cd20.why: gameMainThread, end of each frame: after a requested reset (gp-0x7ae0) sceGsResetPath + sceGsResetGraph(1,..) + sceDmaReset; then sceGsSyncPath(0,0) and, on a timeout, resets the path and DMA until sceGsSyncPath(1,1) succeeds

0012cdf0.name: GameSystem::flipFrame
0012cdf0.why: (this, vsyncs), once per frame from gameMainThread: when +0 is set, heap-use and packet-use bars on the PerfMeter (Heap::markedUsage / 27 MB, GetUsedSize / GetBufferSize) and a GS FINISH packet on list 13; then GamePacketManager::endFrame, PerfMeter::beginFrame, MasterClock::update(vsyncs), FlushCache, GamePacketManager::kickAndSwap

0012d0d0.name: GameSystem::GameSystem
0012d0d0.why: ctor of the 0x540-byte global object gameInit news (gp-0x7aec): +0 debug meter mode, three pads at +4 / +0x17c / +0x2f4 (Pad ctor, ports 0, 1, 1; vptrs 0x311020, the third 0x311030), GamePacketManager at +0x46c, PerfMeter at +0x4a8, MasterClock at +0x510; points each pad's +0x174 at the options' button map (getGameOptions()+0x24); class name provisional (the frame / system object)

0012d2c0.name: GamePad::computeSticks
0012d2c0.why: (this): from the raw stick floats +0x28..+0x34 builds square-to-circle normalised sticks (+0x124..+0x130), their lengths (+0x144..+0x150) and angles through 0x119b88 (atan2?) at +0x134..+0x140; called by the vtable-0x311020 / 0x311030 update slots (0x12dc60, 0x12dcb0) after Pad::update returns new data

0012d620.name: gameInit
0012d620.why: main's first call after __init_cpp, with argv[0]: heap init 0x104600, 0x1527a0(argv0, 0xf, 0x4f, 0x51), sceGsSyncV waits, seeds the RNG from 0x23de20's bytes, constructs the 0x540-byte global object at gp-0x7aec (ctor 0x12d0d0), AddDmacHandler(15, 0x12dc20)

0012d770.name: gsClearVram
0012d770.why: gameInit: builds a 256x256 sceGsSetDefDrawEnv + sceGsSetDefClear (0x780 / 0x700 offsets) packet and sends it on DMA ch 2 (GIF) repeatedly, stepping FRAME.FBP by 32 pages each pass, so the whole GS memory is cleared before display

0012d910.name: main
0012d910.why: entry 0x100204 calls it with argc (0x31af80) and argv (0x31af84) after FlushCache/EI, then jumps to exit with its result

0012dd70.name: GamePacketManager::kickAndSwap
0012dd70.why: (this): FlushCache, Vif1PktManage::Kick unless +0x34 is set (cleared after), then Vif1PktManage::Reset onto the other buffer; the last call of GameSystem::flipFrame

0012ddc0.name: GamePacketManager::endFrame
0012ddc0.why: (this): FlushCache, +0x30 = -1, Vif1PktManage::Terminate (chains the lists and ends the DMA chain); GameSystem::flipFrame calls it before the kick

0012de00.name: GamePacketManager::openList
0012de00.why: (this, id): closes the open list if it is another one (Close + IsOverflow), stores +0x30 = id and returns Vif1PktManage::Open(id), the list whose +0 is the write pointer; GameSystem::flipFrame opens list 13 for its GS FINISH packet

0012de80.name: GamePacketManager::~GamePacketManager
0012de80.why: (this, short flag): vptr 0x311040 (its only slot), then Vif1PktManage::~Vif1PktManage(this, 0), frees when flag > 0

0012dee0.name: GamePacketManager::GamePacketManager
0012dee0.why: (this, buf0, size0, buf1, size1): Vif1PktManage base, vptr 0x311040 at +0x2c, registers the two 0xc0000-byte packet buffers 0x32e280 / 0x3ee280 (double buffer) and 14 lists (ids 0..13), Reset + Terminate, +0x30 open list id = -1, +0x34 skip-kick flag; GameSystem member +0x46c

0012e3f0.name: gfxInitRenderTargets
0012e3f0.why: gameInit: sets up two offscreen draw + clear environments (256x256 at 0x4ae7c0, 512x512 at 0x4ae280, both through sceGsSetDefDrawEnv / sceGsSetDefClear and 0x12ec10) and the VRAM managers 0x31ad9c (0x143f50, five page ranges up to 0x3700), 0x31ada0 (0x143270) and 0x31ad98 (0x2e14d0, handed to 0x2d7cf0); name provisional

0012f1b0.name: RcntTimer::~RcntTimer
0012f1b0.why: (this, short flag): frees when flag > 0, nothing else; PerfMeter::~PerfMeter calls it with 0

0012f200.name: RcntTimer::RcntTimer
0012f200.why: (hz, fps, this, n): +0x10 = 1e6 / hz (us per tick; 15625 = PAL H-blank), +0x14 fps, +0x18 n, starts RCNT1 on H-blank once (gp-0x7ac4, the flag rcnt1Start uses), +0 = RCNT1_COUNT; PerfMeter's base

0012f260.name: rcnt1Start
0012f260.why: gameInit: once (gp-0x7ac4), RCNT1_MODE = 0x83 (count on H-blank, counting enabled)

0012f300.name: Pad::update
0012f300.why: base virtual (slot 0 of vtable 0x311050 through the thunk 0x130060): once per input frame (gp-0x7abc), reads its port record 0x4aed00 + port*0x180: +0xc terminal mode, +0x14 held / +0x10 previous (inverted libpad words), +0x18 pressed, +0x1c released, pressure bytes through the table 0x2f3890, sticks 0x12f6b0; returns 1 on new data, 0 same frame, -1 no pad

0012f960.name: Pad::clear
0012f960.why: (this): zeroes the button / stick / pressure state (+0x10..+0x50) and centres the analog bytes +0x24 at 0x80, the same clearing Pad::Pad and Pad::update do; the vtable-0x311030 pad's update calls it while L1+L2 (0x5) are held

0012fa90.name: Pad::~Pad
0012fa90.why: (this, short flag): restores vptr 0x311050 at +0x120, Pad::setListening(0) when +8 is set, frees when flag > 0 (CodeWarrior deleting dtor); main's teardown runs it on the three pads of the global object

0012fcf0.name: Pad::Pad
0012fcf0.why: (this, port, listen): vptr 0x311050 at +0x120, clears the state (+0x10 20 bytes, +0x24 four analog bytes 0x80 = centred, +0x28 16 bytes, +0x38 25 pressure bytes), +4 port, registers in the 16-slot listener table 0x4af000 when listen (Pad::setListening), 25 {7, 9, 0} entries at +0x54; GameSystem::GameSystem builds three

0012fed0.name: Pad::setListening
0012fed0.why: (this, on): on adds this to a free slot of the 16 input listeners 0x4af000 (1 if already there, -1 if full), off removes it (2 if absent); padSysUpdate calls slot 0 of each listener per frame

0012ffa0.name: padSysUpdate
0012ffa0.why: gameMainThread, per frame: PadPort::read on both port records 0x4aed00 when libpad is up, bumps the input frame counter 0x31adb4 (skipping 0), calls slot +8 of each of the 16 listeners 0x4af000 (vptr at +0x120), returns the counter

00130130.name: padSysInit
00130130.why: gameInit: scePadInit(0) once (flag 0x31adb0), scePadPortOpen(port 0..1, slot 0) on the 0x180-byte port records 0x4aed00 (DMA buffer first, +0x158 open, +0x159 ok, +0x15c port), clears the 16 input listener slots 0x4af000 and the input frame counter 0x31adb4

00130230.name: PadPort::read
00130230.why: (port record): keeps last frame's 0x20-byte state (+0x100 -> +0x120), clears it (+0x102/+0x103 0xff = no buttons), reads the pad through libpad state / read / mode calls 0x11ed60.. 0x11f440 on port +0x15c; padSysUpdate calls it for ports 0 and 1

00130a30.name: threadSetSwitchHook
00130a30.why: (fn, arg): stores the callback the scheduler 0x131290 calls with (slot, arg) after each switch back (gp-0x7aa0 / -0x7a98); main sets 0x12dab0 with globalObject+0x4a8, later clears it

00130bc0.name: threadYield
00130bc0.why: (ticks): FlushCache, checks the current slot's stack canary 0x572a8b4c (hangs in sceGsSyncV if smashed), sets state 1 with the count, wakes the scheduler and sleeps; returns the slot's +0x14 result

00130c90.name: threadSlotCreate
00130c90.why: (fn, slot, arg, cleanup, stack, stacksize): tears down what slot (0x4c7840 + slot*0x24) held, CreateThread with the given or the slot's default stack (0x2f38c0 table), state 2 (start pending), writes the canary 0x572a8b4c at the stack base

00130e00.name: threadRunMain
00130e00.why: (fn): threadSlotCreate(fn, 0, ...), current slot = -1, StartThread(scheduler), WaitSema(8548) until the scheduler releases main; main passes gameMainThread

00130e50.name: threadSysShutdown
00130e50.why: main's teardown of threadSysInit: sceGsSyncVCallback(0), deletes the frame-sync thread and sema, the scheduler thread and semas, then each live slot's thread and calls its cleanup fn (+0x10) with its arg (+0xc)

00130f60.name: threadSysInit
00130f60.why: (frameReady fn, interval): clears the 8 x 0x24-byte thread slot table 0x4c7840, CreateSema 8548 / 802c, creates the scheduler thread 0x131290 (prio 0x40, stack 0x4c81b0) and the job worker 0x131720 (prio 0x50), then frameSyncInit; main passes 0x12db70 and 2

00131260.name: frameSyncWait
00131260.why: sets the frame request flag 0x4c8160, WaitSema(802c), returns the vsync count of that frame (gp-0x7aac); gameMainThread passes it to 0x12cdf0

00131290.name: threadScheduler
00131290.why: scheduler thread body: installs vblank callback 0x131840, steps the current slot 0..7 round-robin (with a push/pop override stack at 0x4c8170), starts state-2 slots (StartThread), wakes state-1 slots whose tick count ran out, SleepThread between, pre/post switch hooks

00131720.name: jobWorkerThread
00131720.why: spins on the job list 0x4c8b38, runs job->fn(job->arg) (+8 / +0xc) under DIntr/EIntr bookkeeping, frees the record when it returns 0, re-queues it at the tail 0x4c8b3c otherwise

00131870.name: frameSyncInit
00131870.why: (frameReady fn, interval): clears the frame-sync record 0x4c8160 (+8 = interval), CreateSema 8034, creates and starts thread 0x131930 (prio 0x10, stack 0x4c7960)

00131930.name: frameSyncThread
00131930.why: loops on WaitSema(8034), counts vsyncs in 0x4c8164; a frame is ready when requested and count >= interval, or when the frameReady callback says so; then stores the count in gp-0x7aac and SignalSema(802c)

00132f30.name: PerfMeter::dumpGroups
00132f30.why: (this): walks the markers for groups 0..7 and does nothing with them (its output stripped in this build); GameSystem::flipFrame calls it while pad 2's +0x18 bit 0x400 (R3 pressed) is set

00133350.name: PerfMeter::collectStats
00133350.why: (this, group): when enabled (+0x40) for up to 300 samples, per marker of the group: min / max / sum of the time since the previous marker into +0x44 / +0x48 / +0x4c, every +0x60 frames the next sample; GameSystem::flipFrame passes 4

00133620.name: PerfMeter::beginFrame
00133620.why: (this): marker count +0x34 and +0x38 = 0, RcntTimer::reset; GameSystem::flipFrame calls it every frame

00133630.name: PerfMeter::~PerfMeter
00133630.why: (this, short flag): frees the marker and stats arrays (+0x3c, +0x44, +0x48, +0x4c), RcntTimer::~RcntTimer(this, 0), frees when flag > 0

001336e0.name: PerfMeter::PerfMeter
001336e0.why: (this, entries 0x30, x 0x20, y 0x1d6, w 0xc0, h 0x18): RcntTimer base (15625 Hz, 50 fps), rect +0x20..+0x2c, capacity +0x30, 16-byte marker array +0x3c (operator new[]), stats arrays +0x44 / +0x48 / +0x4c; GameSystem member +0x4a8: the debug CPU / heap meter

001351b0.name: Clock::~Clock
001351b0.why: (this, short flag): ClockNode::~ClockNode(this, 0), frees when flag > 0; deletes clocks from Clock::createChild (GameSystem::GameSystem, 0x151550, 0x18b330, 0x19bbe0, 0x20aba0, 0x25bc70, ...)

00135210.name: Clock::createChild
00135210.why: (this): new 0x1c-byte Clock {0, 0, 0, 0, scale 0x100, parent this, no children} added to this's children list +0x18 (a PtrList made on first use, grown by 16)

001352d0.name: MasterClock::update
001352d0.why: (this, vsyncs): vsync total += vsyncs, then Clock::advance with ticks per frame, scaled by vsyncs / interval when +0x2c is set; GameSystem::flipFrame passes the vsyncs frameSyncWait returned

00135330.name: MasterClock::~MasterClock
00135330.why: (this, short flag): same body as Clock::~Clock; main's teardown runs it on GameSystem +0x510

00135390.name: MasterClock::MasterClock
00135390.why: (this, rate 12, interval 2, paused, variable): Clock fields {+0 state, +4 time, +8 delta, +0xc time2, +0x10 scale 0x100 (8.8), +0x14 parent, +0x18 children} plus +0x1c, +0x20 ticks per frame, +0x24 vsync total, +0x28 frame interval, +0x2c variable-rate flag; GameSystem member +0x510

001354a0.name: Clock::advance
001354a0.why: (this, ticks): d = ticks * scale (+0x10, 8.8) >> 8, 0 while paused (+0 == 1); time +4 and +0xc += d, delta +8 = d; recurses into every child of +0x18 (PtrList::next): a hierarchical game clock (slow motion / pause per subtree)

00135550.why: (this, short flag): detaches every child (clears its parent +0x14), frees the children PtrList, removes this from its parent's list (freeing the list when it empties), frees this when flag > 0; the shared body of Clock::~Clock and MasterClock::~MasterClock; class split provisional

001357c0.name: PtrList::next
001357c0.why: (list, after): the first non-null entry after 'after' (from the start when 0), or 0; Clock::advance iterates children with it

00135860.name: PtrList::add
00135860.why: (list {u16 capacity, u16 count, void **data}, p, grow): grows the array by grow slots (Heap::alloc / Heap::realloc, zeroed) when full, stores p in the first empty slot, returns the count

001375c0.name: DisableIntc

00137628.name: EnableIntc
00137628.why: libkernl wrapper: _EnableIntc(cause) + sync between DIntr / EIntr when interrupts were on

00137c20.name: StartThread
00137c20.why: libkernl wrapper: ReferThreadStatus, clears the new thread's saved register area on its stack under DIntr, then _StartThread(tid, arg)

001397c8.name: scePrintf
